title: 预订规则解读器
prompt: 这间房写着限时免费取消，到底什么时候之前能退？早餐和儿童入住怎么算？
program:
root = Col([header, sample, tool, policyNote, closing])

header = Col([Title("限时免费取消、早餐与儿童入住", "xl"), Text("选择入住信息后，页面按示例政策即时计算免费取消截止时间和附加费用。", "md", "muted")], 2)
sample = Badge("示例数据 · 不构成真实预订", "warning")

tool = TravelModule([
  FieldRow("入住日期", [DatePicker($checkin, "选择入住日期", @Today())], "未选择时按 14 天后的示例日期计算"),
  FieldRow("房价方案", [SegmentedControl($plan, ["限时免费取消", "不可退款"])]),
  FieldRow("入住人数", [Row([Input($adults, "成人", "number"), Input($children, "儿童", "number")], 2)], "成人 1–6 名，儿童 0–3 名"),
  (children > 0) ? FieldRow("儿童年龄", [SegmentedControl($childAge, ["0–5岁", "6–11岁", "12岁及以上"])]) : null,
  FieldRow("早餐", [Col([Checkbox($breakfast, "为每位成人加购早餐（¥128/位）"), (children > 0) ? Checkbox($childBreakfast, "为每位儿童加购早餐（¥64/位）") : null], 1)]),
  Row([fillDate, Spacer(), resetBtn], 2),
  Row([Caption("免费取消截止"), Spacer(), Text(deadlineText, "sm", "ink", "semibold")], 2),
  Row([Caption("儿童费用 / 晚"), Spacer(), Text(childFeeText, "sm", "ink", "semibold")], 2),
  Row([Caption("早餐费用 / 晚"), Spacer(), Text(breakfastFeeText, "sm", "ink", "semibold")], 2),
  (children > 0 || $breakfast) ? Row([Caption("附加费用合计 / 晚"), Spacer(), Text("¥" + @Format(extraFeeTotal, "number", 0), "md", "ink", "semibold")], 2) : null
], "form", "政策试算", "示例房价 ¥680/晚，不包含在下方附加费用中")

policyNote = Col([
  Title("示例政策速览", "md"),
  List([
    "限时免费取消：入住日前 3 天 18:00 前可免费取消。",
    "儿童入住：0–5 岁免费不占床；6–11 岁 ¥150/晚；12 岁及以上按成人加床 ¥300/晚。",
    "早餐：成人 ¥128/位；6–11 岁儿童 ¥64/位；0–5 岁免费。",
    "以上为示例数据，不构成真实预订或酒店承诺。"
  ], "bullet")
], 2)

closing = Text("实际免费取消截止可能因渠道、会员等级和入住日期变动，请在支付前以订单确认页时间为准。", "sm", "muted")

fillDate = Button("填入示例日期", @Set($checkin, @AddDays(@Today(), 14)), "ghost", null, "sm", "calendar")
resetBtn = Button("重置", @Reset($checkin, $plan, $adults, $children, $breakfast, $childBreakfast, $childAge), "ghost", null, "sm", "rotate-ccw")

checkin = @Default($checkin, @AddDays(@Today(), 14))
adults = @Clamp(@Default($adults, 2), 1, 6)
children = @Clamp(@Default($children, 0), 0, 3)
plan = @Default($plan, "限时免费取消")
deadlineDate = @AddDays(checkin, -3)
isFlexible = plan == "限时免费取消"
deadlineText = isFlexible ? @FormatDate(deadlineDate, "long") + " 18:00 前可免费取消" : "预订后不可取消或修改"
childUnitStayFee = $childAge == "0–5岁" ? 0 : ($childAge == "6–11岁" ? 150 : 300)
childStayFee = children * childUnitStayFee
childFeeText = children == 0 ? "0 元（未选择儿童）" : "¥" + @Format(childStayFee, "number", 0) + " / 晚（" + children + " 名 " + $childAge + "）"
adultBreakfastFee = $breakfast ? adults * 128 : 0
childBreakfastUnit = $childAge == "0–5岁" ? 0 : ($childAge == "6–11岁" ? 64 : 128)
childBreakfastFee = $childBreakfast && children > 0 ? children * childBreakfastUnit : 0
breakfastFeeTotal = adultBreakfastFee + childBreakfastFee
breakfastFeeText = breakfastFeeTotal == 0 ? "未加购" : "¥" + @Format(breakfastFeeTotal, "number", 0) + " / 晚"
extraFeeTotal = childStayFee + breakfastFeeTotal

$checkin = ""
$plan = "限时免费取消"
$adults = 2
$children = 0
$childAge = "6–11岁"
$breakfast = false
$childBreakfast = false
